verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Veo is reachable through the Gemini API, including the Interactions API, a model ID (veo-2.0-generate-001) and GCP billing. However, no item mentions an official SDK, client library, or language binding, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. API access alone is a building block, not an evidenced official SDK, so this applicable axis has no direct support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
